name: Usenet Thread
summary: A thread of plain-text posts in a newsgroup, read in a terminal newsreader: a tree of subject lines, quoted lines that start with >, and a signature under each post.

philosophy.core_thesis: A discussion is a tree of plain-text replies, and each reply quotes the part that it answers.
design_principles: Set all text in one monospace face at one size, 80 characters to a line.
Show the thread as a tree of subject lines, with 2 spaces of indent for each reply level.
Start each quoted line with '> ', and add one more '>' for each older level.
Put a header block on each post: From, Newsgroups, Subject and Date, one field to a line.
End each post with a signature of at most 4 lines after a line of '-- '.
Mark the current line in the thread list with reverse video: light text on a dark bar.
anti_patterns: Proportional type and type sizes for hierarchy
Images, avatars and icons in the post body
Colour for meaning other than the cursor bar

layout.grid_mechanics: A character grid of 80 columns by 24 rows; the thread list fills the top half and the post fills the bottom half.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 20% to 30% of the screen stays empty, mostly at the right end of short lines.
layout.alignment_rules: All text aligns left on the character grid; replies indent 2 characters for each level of the tree.
layout.container_geometry: No containers; a rule of '-' or '=' characters separates the list and the post.

font_pairings.note: One monospace face for all text, as on a terminal.
A terminal face for headers and a typewriter face for the text.

hierarchy_rules: Use one size for all text.
Show hierarchy with indent, with capitals and with reverse video only.
Put header field names in bold or in the muted colour.

color.palette_structure: A dark terminal ground with one text colour and one highlight colour; 3 to 4 colours in all.
color.contrast_rules: Light grey on black is 14:1; quoted text in mid grey is 5:1 and stays readable.
color.surface_treatment: A flat dark screen with no texture.
color.light_and_shadow: No light source and no shadow.

materiality.surface_simulation: A text terminal: glyphs on a flat dark screen.
materiality.border_rules: Rules made of '-' and '=' characters; no drawn borders.

ornamentation_details.iconography: No icons; status flags are letters in a column: N for new, R for read, + for a reply.
ornamentation_details.illustration: ASCII art in a signature only, at most 4 lines.

motion.transition_physics: The screen redraws at once when the reader moves to the next post; the cursor blinks at 1Hz.
motion.hover_and_active: The selected line shows in reverse video; there is no hover.

lineage.root: Usenet is the earliest discussion-group style in the data, so no older style here leads to it.

emotion.target_response: The reader feels the slow, wordy and serious talk of the early net.

use_cases: developer mailing list and changelog pages
avoid_when: The audience expects images and avatars.
The page must sell a product.
Readers use small phone screens only.

modifiers.how: Put the posts in a table with a user column, an avatar and a post count.
Add ANSI colour blocks and a drawn banner at the top.

pack.why: Square pixel icons fit a character grid.

ground.why: A terminal screen: dark rows of glyphs with faint scan lines.
